ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (468) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, italics, footnote markers, and deletion markup preserved.
Translated fresh from the Russian; where a passage coincides with the calendar or a finished story, the reviewed R003 English was reused and changed only where this text differs.

The reserve days are extra numbered days of the first edition, each with a title, an opening thought, numbered readings, and a closing thought; where a reading also stands in the finished calendar (Schopenhauer, Lichtenberg, Seneca, Emerson, Matthew 6, the Indian proverb, the first of the five temptations), the calendar's English is reused and changed only where this earlier wording differs. «Возмездие» (vozmezdie, 'requital, retribution') is rendered "requital" throughout day VII, since it covers reward as well as punishment; «ложь» (lozh', 'lie') is "lie"/"lying" in day IX (John 8:44 "the father of lying"); the source's «Исаии гл. V, ст. 7, 8» (Isaii gl. V, st. 7, 8, 'Isaiah ch. 5, vv. 7, 8') is kept as printed although the quoted text is verse 8 alone. Section headings keep the Roman numerals and capitals: «ОДУРМАНЕНИЕ» (odurmanenie, 'stupefaction'), «УСТРОЙСТВО ЖИЗНИ» (ustroystvo zhizni, 'the arrangement of life'), «ЮРОДСТВО» (yurodstvo, 'holy foolishness'); the Luke 17, Matthew 6, Laozi, and Ruskin passages already in the calendar reuse its finished English, changed only where this printing's wording or punctuation differs (e.g. its Gospel questions end in periods). Printed anomalies are kept and flagged: section numbers 3 missing in days X and XIX, the heading «ХІІа» (XIIa) in mixed script, and «справедливость» (spravedlivost', 'justice') where Carlyle's sense needs 'injustice'.
Source observation: [29] «Исаии гл. V, ст. 7, 8» (Isaiah 5:7, 8): the quoted text is Isaiah 5:8 only; reference kept as printed.
Source observation: [128] «соображении» (soobrazhenii) for «соображений» (soobrazheniy, 'considerations'): one-letter slip; translated as 'considerations'.
Source observation: [129] «Малоpu» is typed with Latin p and u for Cyrillic р and и (Малори, Malori); rendered 'Lucy Mallory' as at [119].

Source observation: [134] «Амшаспанд-Брахман» (Amshaspand-Brakhman) twice: the Avesta's confession (Patet) names Amshaspand Bahman, guardian of cattle; 'Brahman' looks like an error in the source or its Russian intermediary. Translated as printed, 'Amshaspand-Brahman'.
Source observation: [135] «Каорда Авеста» (Kaorda Avesta) for Khorda Avesta (Хорда Авеста); rendered 'Khorda Avesta'.

Source observation: [167] «не затевать ссоры с ближним и не отвечать ему на его приветствие» ('not to start a quarrel with one's neighbor and not to answer his greeting'): the sense wants 'and to answer his greeting'; the second «не» ('not') looks like a slip. Translated as printed.

Source observation: [176] The first number of day VIII is printed bold («**1**») and set as a text block, unlike every other number; day VIII also has no opening thought between its title and reading 1. Kept as printed.

Source observation: [177] «Если адвокатуры, искусство и медицина» ('if the bars, art, and medicine'): plural «адвокатуры» for «адвокатура» (advokatura, 'the bar'), as in the three earlier mentions; translated 'the bar'.
Source observation: [187] stray «**» after «10000 рублей,» (10,000 rubles): no footnote follows; omitted in the English.
Source observation: [238] Reserve day X: the section number 3 is missing before this Talmud group (the numbering runs 1, 2, 4–9); translated as printed.

Source observation: [304] The heading prints «ХІІа» with Cyrillic Х and Belarusian-Ukrainian І letters instead of Latin XII; rendered 'XIIa'. The section's thoughts (love of God, renouncing one's own will) have nothing to do with its title «ОДУРМАНЕНИЕ ПРИБАВЛЕНИЕ» (odurmanenie pribavlenie, 'stupefaction, supplement'); title translated as printed.

Source observation: [316] Channing: «Идея свободы — в древних и новых религиях» ('the idea of freedom—in ancient and new religions'); Channing's sense (and the pairing with 'religious sects') suggests a slip for «республиках» (respublikakh, 'republics'); translated as printed.
Source observation: [344] [345] Luke 17:7–8 is printed with final periods instead of question marks (the calendar text for 1 November has «?»); periods kept as printed.
Source observation: [396] The sage's reply opens a quotation («Это прекрасный вопрос…) that is never closed; left unclosed as printed.

Source observation: [425] Carlyle: «если справедливость остается годы и даже столетия не наказанной» ('if justice remains unpunished for years and even centuries'); the sense requires «несправедливость» (nespravedlivost', 'injustice'); translated as printed. The rhetorical question «неужели … вам всё еще напоминать…» also ends in a period, kept.
Source observation: [461] Reserve day XIX: the section number 3 is missing before this Conway thought (the numbering runs 1, 2, 4, 5); translated as printed.
